name: xerj
description: Local-first BM25, vector and hybrid search, code search and agent memory over your own indexed files.
long_description: XERJ is a local search engine with an Elasticsearch-compatible API. `xerj autoindex` indexes code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV and PDFs; this bundle runs `xerj mcp`, the MCP stdio server that proxies search, memory, second-brain, field-map, code-search and Corpus Hub tools to a XERJ node. The node must already be running (`xerj --insecure --data-dir ~/xerj-data`); this bundle does not start one. Install the CLI with `curl -fsSL https://xerj.org/get | sh` to create and index data.

xerj_url.title: XERJ node URL
xerj_url.description: ES-compatible listener of a running XERJ node. For a loopback node the API key is read from <data-dir>/admin.key automatically.
